name: ophis
title: Ophis MCP
description: Fourteen agent-facing tools for the Ophis DEX: parse swap intents, resolve trusted tokens, fetch best-execution quotes, build and validate bounded signable CoW orders, relay pre-signed orders, and inspect tiers, integrator earnings, chains, balances, portfolios, gas, charts, and expected surplus. Public, unauthenticated, and keyless: the server never holds keys or signs; build_order pins the order receiver to the owner and the agent signs locally.

tools.name: parse_intent
tools.description: Natural-language swap request -> structured intent (intent + entities).

tools.name: resolve_token
tools.description: Resolve a token symbol to its canonical address from the trusted Ophis/CoW token list; fails closed (anti-spoof). Run before quoting/building.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Best-execution quote from the chain's Ophis orderbook.

tools.name: build_order
tools.description: A bounded, ready-to-sign EIP-712 CoW order (receiver pinned to owner; correct per-chain settlement; CIP-75 partner fee).

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Relay a pre-signed order to the orderbook.

tools.name: lookup_tier
tools.description: A wallet's fee-rebate tier and live status.

tools.name: get_integrator_earnings
tools.description: Integrator routed volume, own-fee accrual, referral rebates, and paid-to-date figures by appCode.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Supported chains with orderbook host and settlement contract.

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: A wallet's native and ERC-20 balances on one chain via a public RPC.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: A wallet's token balances across multiple chains.

tools.name: get_gas
tools.description: Current gas price for a chain.

tools.name: expected_surplus
tools.description: Estimate how much better an Ophis sell-quote beats the open market (beatBps).

tools.name: validate_order
tools.description: Validate a proposed order against Ophis safety and routing invariants before signing.
